title.zh: ZachXBT: AXIS Insiders Dump ~42M Tokens From Team Multisig, Triggering 40% Crash
title.en: ZachXBT: AXIS Insiders Dump ~42M Tokens From Team Multisig, Triggering 40% Crash

current_state.zh: ZachXBT alleges AXIS insiders received over 76M tokens (~$12M) from the team multisig and dumped roughly 42M (~$5.04M) via DEXs into Bitget, crashing the price 40% days after Binance, Coinbase and Upbit listings.
current_state.en: ZachXBT alleges AXIS insiders received over 76M tokens (~$12M) from the team multisig and dumped roughly 42M (~$5.04M) via DEXs into Bitget, crashing the price 40% days after Binance, Coinbase and Upbit listings.

updates.title_zh: ZachXBT：AXIS 内部人士从团队多签钱包抛售约 4200 万枚代币，引发 40% 暴跌
updates.title_en: ZachXBT: AXIS Insiders Dump ~42M Tokens From Team Multisig, Triggering 40% Crash
updates.what_changed_zh:
链上调查员 ZachXBT 称，Axis Robotics 的疑似内部人士从团队多签钱包获得逾 7600 万枚 AXIS 代币（价值超过 1200 万美元），随后通过去中心化交易所抛售，并将资金存入 Bitget。据 ZachXBT 说法，其中一名内部人士直接从团队多签钱包抛售约 4200 万枚代币（约合 504 万 USDC），导致 AXIS 在登陆 Coinbase、Upbit 和 Binance 约一周后价格暴跌 40%。

Axis Robotics 对此作出回应，称团队和投资者持有的 83.5% 代币仍锁定在由 Binance 共同管理的归属合约中，12 个月内不会解锁，并称被抛售的代币来自初始流通的生态分配额度，已交给一家场外交易对手方，而该对手方违反了锁仓条款。公司表示已暂停与该对手方的关系、启动法律程序，并承诺未来生态代币仅通过链上归属机制发放。

ZachXBT 质疑团队为何花了整整两天才注意到约 25% 的代币生成事件（TGE）流通量被抛售，以及为何在他发帖前团队既未阻止抛售、也未发布公开声明。双方对代币来源说法不一：ZachXBT 将其归因于团队多签钱包，而 Axis 归因于场外交易对手方违约。

updates.background_zh: ZachXBT 是一位化名区块链调查员，以对加密货币欺诈、骗局和盗窃进行独立链上取证调查而知名。多签钱包需要多方批准才能转移资金，通常用于持有项目财库和团队份额。场外交易（OTC）由交易双方私下协商、在交易所以外完成结算，而非在公开订单簿上撮合。
updates.background_en: ZachXBT is a pseudonymous blockchain investigator known for independent on-chain forensic work on crypto fraud, scams and thefts. A multisig wallet requires approval from multiple parties before funds can move, and is commonly used to hold project treasuries and team allocations. OTC trades are negotiated privately between two counterparties and settled off exchange rather than on a public order book.
updates.market_impact_zh: 影响集中在 AXIS 本身：Binance、Coinbase 和 Upbit 上的持有者在上市数日后即遭遇据称 40% 的回撤，而这一争议也凸显出即便归属合约仍处于锁仓状态，团队与生态分配额度仍可能通过场外交易安排流入公开市场。此事看来并非波及更广泛加密市场的系统性事件。
updates.market_impact_en: The impact is concentrated in AXIS itself: holders on Binance, Coinbase and Upbit were exposed to a reported 40% drawdown days after listing, and the dispute highlights how team and ecosystem allocations can reach the open market through OTC arrangements even when vesting contracts remain locked. It does not appear to be a systemic event for broader crypto markets.
